retrievalProfile.description: A mid-century vocal jazz aesthetic featuring a high-contrast black and white portrait offset by bold, staggered slab-serif typography in a vibrant secondary color.
triggerTerms: high-contrast monochrome portrait with red slab serif text

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical composition split between a desaturated, high-contrast monochrome portrait on the left and a right-aligned, multi-line typographic block in a bold, warm hue. The layout is framed by a clean white border with technical metadata in the corners and a centered header graphic.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject-to-text balance across the vertical axis
High-contrast monochrome photography against flat spot-color type
Staggered line lengths creating a rhythmic typographic flow
Technical header framing the top edge
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white photography with blown-out highlights
A primary accent color (typically red or orange) for the main title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot of a male figure, positioned on the left third, looking upward with hands clasped.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold, colored title text on the right side of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows the upward gaze, then moves across to the top of the text block and descends through the staggered lines.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space at the top and right margins to allow the technical markings and text to breathe.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white/Cream background for a vintage paper feel.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black for the photographic subject and secondary metadata.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange-red for the primary display typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the photo; high saturation contrast between the text and the neutral background.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to black, white, and one primary accent color.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with high stroke contrast and ball terminals.
letterConstructionRules: Italicized or slanted for dynamic movement
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'a' with a prominent teardrop terminal
Uppercase 'J' with a deep, rounded hook
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair the bold display slab serif with a smaller, lighter weight of the same family or a clean, high-contrast serif for metadata.
graphicDevices: Small circular logo icons in the upper right

avoid: Centered text for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast slab serif and ball terminal aesthetic.
Captures the extreme stroke contrast and mid-century elegance.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photograph of a man in a sweater looking up joyfully, positioned on the left side of a cream-colored square canvas. Leave the right side and top edge clear.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned text in a bold, orange-red slab-serif font. Place a 'STEREO' header inside a thin rectangle with arrows at the top center. Add small technical metadata in the corners using a light serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the main title right-aligned and staggered?
Is the accent color a vibrant orange-red?
Is the 'Stereo' header present at the top center?

postGenerationChecks: Check that text does not overlap the subject's face
Ensure the cream background has a subtle paper texture
Verify the slab-serif font has high stroke contrast
Confirm the right-alignment is consistent across all title lines
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W portrait (Left) + Staggered Slab-Serif Type (Right) + Technical Header (Top) = Mid-Century Jazz Aesthetic.
